summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing a quarterly dividend of US$0.03 per common share, aggregating US$0.12 for fiscal 2026. Record date is September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 15, 2026. Registered shareholders may elect to receive dividends in kind as Tether Gold XAU tokens, with Equiniti and Bullish (NYSE: BLSH) facilitating. Elections must be received by September 24, 2026. The board retains discretion over future dividends. Watch for participation rates and any regulatory constraints.
